examples.name: Default
examples.summary: A chat page: the history in a side panel beside the conversation on wide screens and in a start-side `Drawer` opened from a menu button on phones. New chat and a search field sit on top; conversations are grouped Today, Yesterday, Previous 7 days, Previous 30 days and Older against a fixed `now`; Delete on every row asks in a `ConfirmDialog` before the conversation goes.

examples.name: States
examples.summary: Loading (five placeholder rows, `aria-busy`) and empty (`No conversations yet.`).

examples.name: Projects
examples.summary: Chats organized by project in a side panel: a collapsible Projects section with an Organize menu (sort by Recent activity or Name) and a New project button, three projects with storefront expanded to show its chats, then Recents with the chats outside any project in their date groups. Search filters across projects and Recents.

examples.name: RichRows
examples.summary: A chat side panel with a toolbar (Search, New project, New chat), a Pinned group, rows with a tag, a description, their age and a running or failed status, and every row and project action applied to the data: pin, rename inline, share, lock, move to a project, archive and delete with Undo.

examples.name: StatusGroups
examples.summary: `groupBy="status"`: Working holds the two running chats, Settled the finished, failed and archived ones, collapsed until opened; each row shows its age.
